title: Postponing a restart
passage:
Could we reboot the server after the demonstration?
A. The screen is beside the server rack.
B. Yes, I'll reschedule it for half past five.
C. I demonstrated it to the client.
passageZh:
可以等示範結束後再重新啟動伺服器嗎？
A. 螢幕在伺服器機櫃旁。
B. 可以，我會把時間改到五點半。
C. 我已向客戶展示過它。
